crossRefs.note: having a great and high wall; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names written on them, which are…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
translations.bsb: The twelve stones corresponded to the names of the sons of Israel. Each stone was engraved like a seal with the name of one of the twelve tribes.
translations.kjv: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names, like the engravings of a signet, every one with his name, according to the twelve tribes.
translations.asv: And the stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, every one according to his name, for the twelve tribes.
